schools.name: Tuck School of Business at Dartmouth
schools.description: Tuck School of Business at Dartmouth is a premier business school known for its intimate, residential community and rigorous general management curriculum. Located in Hanover, New Hampshire, Tuck offers a uniquely immersive MBA experience with a strong emphasis on close-knit relationships among students, faculty, and alumni. The program consistently produces leaders across consulting, finance, and technology shaped by Tuck's collaborative culture and global perspective.

curriculum.year1: First-year students complete a 32-week integrated core curriculum covering 13 required courses across analytics, corporate finance, economics, marketing, organizational behavior, strategy, communications, and operations. The year culminates in the First-Year Project (FYP), where teams of five tackle complex real-world business challenges for actual clients.
curriculum.year2: Second-year students design their own education by selecting 12 electives from over 100 courses. Students can pursue a focused field of study or explore broadly across disciplines.

learningMethods.name: First-Year Project (FYP)
